statement:
theorem infiniteSpace_le_homogeneous (n : ℕ) :
    infiniteSpace F waiting size n ≤ homogeneous F (2 ^ n)
proof:
:= by
  let j := activeStage F waiting size n
  have hlo := activeStage_lower F waiting size n
  change stageHeight F waiting size j ≤ n at hlo
  have hn : (stagePrefix F waiting size j).height +
      (n - stageHeight F waiting size j) = n := by
    change stageHeight F waiting size j + (n - stageHeight F waiting size j) = n
    omega
  simpa only [infiniteSpace, hn, j] using
    stageSpace_le_homogeneous F (stagePrefix F waiting size j) (size j) (waiting j)
      (n - stageHeight F waiting size j)

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.infiniteSpace_ne_bot
statement: theorem infiniteSpace_ne_bot (n : ℕ) : infiniteSpace F waiting size n ≠ ⊥
proof:
:=
  stageSpace_ne_bot F _ _ _ _

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.infiniteSpace_coherent
statement:
theorem infiniteSpace_coherent (n : ℕ) :
    infiniteSpace F waiting size (n + 1) ≤
      productSpan F (infiniteSpace F waiting size n) (infiniteSpace F waiting size n)
proof:
:= by
  let j := activeStage F waiting size n
  let a := n - stageHeight F waiting size j
  have hlo := activeStage_lower F waiting size n
  have hhi := activeStage_upper F waiting size n
  change stageHeight F waiting size j ≤ n at hlo
  change n < stageHeight F waiting size (j + 1) at hhi
  have hn : stageHeight F waiting size j + a = n := by dsimp only [a]; omega
  have ha : a < waiting j + operationHeight (size j) := by
    have hs := stageHeight_succ F waiting size j
    omega
  have hn1 : stageHeight F waiting size j + (a + 1) = n + 1 := by omega
  rw [← hn1, infiniteSpace_at_stage F waiting size j (a + 1) (by omega)]
  rw [← hn, infiniteSpace_at_stage F waiting size j a (by omega)]
  exact stageSpace_coherent F _ _ _ _ ha

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.infiniteSpace_stage_endpoint_killed
statement:
theorem infiniteSpace_stage_endpoint_killed (C : Type*) [CommRing C] [Algebra F C]
    (j : ℕ) (f : WordAlgebra F →ₐ[F] Matrix (Fin (size j)) (Fin (size j)) C) :
    infiniteSpace F waiting size (stageHeight F waiting size (j + 1)) ≤
      LinearMap.ker f.toLinearMap
proof:
:= by
  have hj := infiniteSpace_at_stage F waiting size j
    (waiting j + operationHeight (size j)) le_rfl
  have hn : stageHeight F waiting size j +
      (waiting j + operationHeight (size j)) = stageHeight F waiting size (j + 1) := by
    rw [stageHeight_succ]
    omega
  rw [hn, stageSpace_endpoint] at hj
  rw [hj]
  exact resetPrefix_space_killed F C _ _ f

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.mem_wordTailSubmodule
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_wordTailSubmodule (N : ℕ) (P : WordAlgebra F) :
    P ∈ wordTailSubmodule F N ↔ ∀ w : Word, w.length < N → P w = 0
proof:
:= by
  change P ∈ Finsupp.supported F F {w : Word | N ≤ w.length} ↔ _
  simpa only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, not_le] using (Finsupp.mem_supported' (s := {w : Word | N ≤ w.length}) F P)

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.wordTailSubmodule_mul_left
statement:
theorem wordTailSubmodule_mul_left (N : ℕ) (P Q : WordAlgebra F)
    (hQ : Q ∈ wordTailSubmodule F N) : P * Q ∈ wordTailSubmodule F N
proof:
:= by
  classical
  change ∀ w ∈ (P * Q).support, N ≤ w.length
  intro w hw
  obtain ⟨u, hu, v, hv, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_mul.mp (MonoidAlgebra.support_mul P Q hw)
  have hvN : N ≤ v.length := hQ hv
  simpa only [FreeMonoid.length_mul] using hvN.trans (Nat.le_add_left v.length u.length)

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.wordTailSubmodule_mul_right
statement:
theorem wordTailSubmodule_mul_right (N : ℕ) (P Q : WordAlgebra F)
    (hP : P ∈ wordTailSubmodule F N) : P * Q ∈ wordTailSubmodule F N
proof:
:= by
  classical
  change ∀ w ∈ (P * Q).support, N ≤ w.length
  intro w hw
  obtain ⟨u, hu, v, hv, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_mul.mp (MonoidAlgebra.support_mul P Q hw)
  have huN : N ≤ u.length := hP hu
  simpa only [FreeMonoid.length_mul] using huN.trans (Nat.le_add_right u.length v.length)

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.mem_wordTailIdeal
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_wordTailIdeal (N : ℕ) (P : WordAlgebra F) :
    P ∈ wordTailIdeal F N ↔ P ∈ wordTailSubmodule F N
proof: := by simp [wordTailIdeal]

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.shortWordProjection_coeff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem shortWordProjection_coeff (N : ℕ) (P : WordAlgebra F) (w : Word) :
    (shortWordProjection F N P).val w = if w.length < N then P w else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  change (Finsupp.filter (fun w : Word => w.length < N) (MonoidAlgebra.coeff P)) w = _
  rw [Finsupp.filter_apply]
  rfl

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.sub_shortWordProjection_mem_tail
statement:
theorem sub_shortWordProjection_mem_tail (N : ℕ) (P : WordAlgebra F) :
    P - (shortWordProjection F N P).val ∈ wordTailSubmodule F N
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_wordTailSubmodule]
  intro w hw
  change P w - (shortWordProjection F N P).val w = 0
  rw [shortWordProjection_coeff, if_pos hw, sub_self]

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.homogeneousProjection_tail_eq_zero
statement:
theorem homogeneousProjection_tail_eq_zero (N n : ℕ) (hn : n < N)
    (P : WordAlgebra F) (hP : P ∈ wordTailSubmodule F N) :
    homogeneousProjection F n P = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Finsupp.ext
  intro w
  rw [homogeneousProjection_coeff]
  by_cases hw : w.length = n
  · rw [if_pos hw]
    exact (mem_wordTailSubmodule F N P).mp hP w (by omega)
  · rw [if_neg hw]
    rfl

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.finiteTruncationQuotientMap_eq_zero_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem finiteTruncationQuotientMap_eq_zero_iff (W : DyadicDualData F)
    (hW : PrimalCoherent F W) (N : ℕ) (P : WordAlgebra F) :
    finiteTruncationQuotientMap F W hW N P = 0 ↔ P ∈ finiteTruncationIdeal F W hW N
proof:
:= by
  change (finiteTruncationIdeal F W hW N).ringCon.mk' P = 0 ↔ _
  rw [← TwoSidedIdeal.mem_ker, TwoSidedIdeal.ker_ringCon_mk']

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.finiteTruncation_short_surjective
statement:
theorem finiteTruncation_short_surjective (W : DyadicDualData F)
    (hW : PrimalCoherent F W) (N : ℕ) :
    Function.Surjective ((finiteTruncationQuotientMap F W hW N).toLinearMap.comp
      (shortWordSubmodule F N).subtype)
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  obtain ⟨P, rfl⟩ := RingCon.mkₐ_surjective (S := F) (finiteTruncationIdeal F W hW N).ringCon x
  refine ⟨shortWordProjection F N P, ?_⟩
  change finiteTruncationQuotientMap F W hW N (shortWordProjection F N P).val =
    finiteTruncationQuotientMap F W hW N P
  apply Eq.symm
  apply sub_eq_zero.mp
  rw [← map_sub]
  apply (finiteTruncationQuotientMap_eq_zero_iff F W hW N _).mpr
  exact TwoSidedIdeal.mem_sup_right ((mem_wordTailIdeal F N _).mpr
    (sub_shortWordProjection_mem_tail F N P))

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.finiteTruncationFactor_map
statement:
@[simp]
theorem finiteTruncationFactor_map (W : DyadicDualData F)
    (hW : PrimalCoherent F W) (N : ℕ) (P : WordAlgebra F) :
    finiteTruncationFactor F W hW N (allCutQuotientMap F W hW P) =
      finiteTruncationQuotientMap F W hW N P
proof: := rfl

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.exists_positive_finiteTruncation_separating
statement:
theorem exists_positive_finiteTruncation_separating (W : DyadicDualData F)
    (hW : PrimalCoherent F W) (a : PositiveAllCutQuotient F W hW) (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, 0 < N ∧ positiveFiniteTruncationMap F W hW N a ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ := allCutQuotientMap_surjective F W hW a.val
  have hPnot : P ∉ allCutSubmodule F W := by
    intro h
    apply ha
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact hP.symm.trans ((allCutQuotientMap_eq_zero_iff F W hW P).mpr h)
  have hex : ∃ n : ℕ, (homogeneousProjection F n P).val ∉ allCutComponent F W n := by
    by_contra h
    push_neg at h
    exact hPnot (mem_allCutSubmodule_of_homogeneousProjections_mem F W P h)
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hex
  refine ⟨n + 1, by omega, ?_⟩
  intro hzero
  have hz : finiteTruncationQuotientMap F W hW (n + 1) P = 0 := by
    rw [← finiteTruncationFactor_map, hP]
    exact hzero
  have hmem := (finiteTruncationQuotientMap_eq_zero_iff F W hW (n + 1) P).mp hz
  obtain ⟨Epart, hE, Tpart, hT, hsum⟩ := TwoSidedIdeal.mem_sup.mp hmem
  have hTzero : homogeneousProjection F n Tpart = 0 :=
    homogeneousProjection_tail_eq_zero F (n + 1) n (by omega) Tpart
      ((mem_wordTailIdeal F (n + 1) Tpart).mp hT)
  have hprojection : homogeneousProjection F n P = homogeneousProjection F n Epart := by
    rw [← hsum, map_add, hTzero, add_zero]
  apply hn
  rw [hprojection]
  exact homogeneousProjection_allCutSubmodule_mem F W n Epart
    ((mem_allCutTwoSidedIdeal F W hW Epart).mp hE)

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.positiveFiniteTruncationSurjection_surjective
statement:
theorem positiveFiniteTruncationSurjection_surjective (W : DyadicDualData F)
    (hW : PrimalCoherent F W) (N : ℕ) :
    Function.Surjective (positiveFiniteTruncationSurjection F W hW N)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨x, hx⟩
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := hx
  exact ⟨a, rfl⟩

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.positive_residually_finite_dimensional
statement:
theorem positive_residually_finite_dimensional (W : DyadicDualData F)
    (hW : PrimalCoherent F W) (a : PositiveAllCutQuotient F W hW) (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, 0 < N ∧ positiveFiniteTruncationSurjection F W hW N a ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, hN, hsep⟩ := exists_positive_finiteTruncation_separating F W hW a ha
  refine ⟨N, hN, ?_⟩
  intro hz
  exact hsep (congrArg Subtype.val hz)

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.degreeProjection_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem degreeProjection_apply (n : ℕ) (P : WordAlgebra F) :
    degreeProjection F n P = (homogeneousProjection F n P).val
proof: := rfl

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.degreeProjection_of_mem
statement:
theorem degreeProjection_of_mem (n : ℕ) (P : WordAlgebra F)
    (hP : P ∈ homogeneous F n) : degreeProjection F n P = P
proof:
:=
  homogeneousProjection_of_mem F n P hP

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.degreeProjection_of_other_degree
statement:
theorem degreeProjection_of_other_degree (m n : ℕ) (hmn : m ≠ n)
    (P : WordAlgebra F) (hP : P ∈ homogeneous F m) : degreeProjection F n P = 0
proof:
:=
  homogeneousProjection_of_other_degree F m n hmn P hP

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.degreeProjection_mem_homogeneous
statement:
theorem degreeProjection_mem_homogeneous (n : ℕ) (P : WordAlgebra F) :
    degreeProjection F n P ∈ homogeneous F n
proof: := (homogeneousProjection F n P).property

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.degreeProjection_single
statement:
theorem degreeProjection_single (n : ℕ) (w : Word) :
    degreeProjection F n (MonoidAlgebra.single w 1) =
      if w.length = n then MonoidAlgebra.single w 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hw : w.length = n
  · rw [if_pos hw]
    exact degreeProjection_of_mem F n _
      (monomial_mem_homogeneous F n ⟨w, hw⟩ 1)
  · rw [if_neg hw]
    exact degreeProjection_of_other_degree F w.length n hw _
      (monomial_mem_homogeneous F w.length ⟨w, rfl⟩ 1)

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.homogeneous_le_shortWordSubmodule
statement:
theorem homogeneous_le_shortWordSubmodule (n : ℕ) :
    homogeneous F n ≤ shortWordSubmodule F (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  intro P hP
  change ∀ w ∈ P.support, w.length = n at hP
  change ∀ w ∈ P.support, w.length < n + 1
  intro w hw
  rw [hP w hw]
  omega

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.shortWordSubmodule_mul
statement:
theorem shortWordSubmodule_mul (m n : ℕ) (P Q : WordAlgebra F)
    (hP : P ∈ shortWordSubmodule F (m + 1))
    (hQ : Q ∈ shortWordSubmodule F (n + 1)) :
    P * Q ∈ shortWordSubmodule F (m + n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  change ∀ w ∈ (P * Q).support, w.length < m + n + 1
  intro w hw
  obtain ⟨u, hu, v, hv, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_mul.mp (MonoidAlgebra.support_mul P Q hw)
  have hum : u.length < m + 1 := hP hu
  have hvn : v.length < n + 1 := hQ hv
  rw [FreeMonoid.length_mul]
  omega

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.degreeProjection_mul_top
statement:
theorem degreeProjection_mul_top (m n : ℕ) (P Q : WordAlgebra F)
    (hP : P ∈ shortWordSubmodule F (m + 1))
    (hQ : Q ∈ shortWordSubmodule F (n + 1)) :
    degreeProjection F (m + n) (P * Q) =
      degreeProjection F m P * degreeProjection F n Q
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hP' : P ∈ Submodule.span F
      ((fun w : Word => MonoidAlgebra.single w (1 : F)) '' {w : Word | w.length < m + 1}) := by
    change P ∈ Finsupp.supported F F {w : Word | w.length < m + 1} at hP
    rw [Finsupp.supported_eq_span_single] at hP
    exact hP
  have hQ' : Q ∈ Submodule.span F
      ((fun w : Word => MonoidAlgebra.single w (1 : F)) '' {w : Word | w.length < n + 1}) := by
    change Q ∈ Finsupp.supported F F {w : Word | w.length < n + 1} at hQ
    rw [Finsupp.supported_eq_span_single] at hQ
    exact hQ
  refine Submodule.span_induction₂
    (p := fun P Q _ _ => degreeProjection F (m + n) (P * Q) =
      degreeProjection F m P * degreeProjection F n Q) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hP' hQ'
  · rintro P Q ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩ ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩
    change u.length < m + 1 at hu
    change v.length < n + 1 at hv
    rw [MonoidAlgebra.single_mul_single, one_mul, degreeProjection_single,
      degreeProjection_single, degreeProjection_single]
    by_cases hum : u.length = m <;> by_cases hvn : v.length = n
    · have huv : (u * v).length = m + n := by simp only [FreeMonoid.length_mul, hum, hvn]
      simp only [if_pos huv, if_pos hum, if_pos hvn, MonoidAlgebra.single_mul_single, one_mul]
    · have huv : (u * v).length ≠ m + n := by rw [FreeMonoid.length_mul]; omega
      simp only [if_neg huv, if_pos hum, if_neg hvn, mul_zero]
    · have huv : (u * v).length ≠ m + n := by rw [FreeMonoid.length_mul]; omega
      simp only [if_neg huv, if_neg hum, if_pos hvn, zero_mul]
    · have huv : (u * v).length ≠ m + n := by rw [FreeMonoid.length_mul]; omega
      simp only [if_neg huv, if_neg hum, if_neg hvn, zero_mul]
  · intro Q hQ
    simp only [zero_mul, map_zero]
  · intro P hP
    simp only [mul_zero, map_zero]
  · intro P Q R hP hQ hR hPR hQR
    simp only [add_mul, map_add, hPR, hQR]
  · intro P Q R hP hQ hR hPQ hPR
    simp only [mul_add, map_add, hPQ, hPR]
  · intro c P Q hP hQ hPQ
    simp only [smul_mul_assoc, map_smul, hPQ]
  · intro c P Q hP hQ hPQ
    simp only [mul_smul_comm, map_smul, hPQ]

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.sub_degreeProjection_mem_short
statement:
theorem sub_degreeProjection_mem_short (n : ℕ) (P : WordAlgebra F)
    (hP : P ∈ shortWordSubmodule F (n + 1)) :
    P - degreeProjection F n P ∈ shortWordSubmodule F n
proof:
:= by
  change P - degreeProjection F n P ∈ Finsupp.supported F F {w : Word | w.length < n}
  apply (Finsupp.mem_supported' (s := {w : Word | w.length < n}) F
    (P - degreeProjection F n P)).mpr
  intro w hw
  change ¬ w.length < n at hw
  change P w - (homogeneousProjection F n P).val w = 0
  rw [homogeneousProjection_coeff]
  by_cases hwn : w.length = n
  · rw [if_pos hwn, sub_self]
  · rw [if_neg hwn, sub_zero]
    have hnot : ¬ w.length < n + 1 := by omega
    exact (Finsupp.mem_supported' (s := {w : Word | w.length < n + 1}) F P).mp hP w hnot

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.shortWordSubmodule_zero
statement:
theorem shortWordSubmodule_zero (P : WordAlgebra F) (hP : P ∈ shortWordSubmodule F 0) :
    P = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Finsupp.ext
  intro w
  change P w = (0 : F)
  exact (Finsupp.mem_supported' (s := {w : Word | w.length < 0}) F P).mp hP w
    (by change ¬ w.length < 0; exact Nat.not_lt_zero _)

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.exists_mem_shortWordSubmodule
statement:
theorem exists_mem_shortWordSubmodule (P : WordAlgebra F) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, P ∈ shortWordSubmodule F (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine ⟨(MonoidAlgebra.coeff P).support.sup (fun w : Word => w.length), ?_⟩
  change ∀ w ∈ (MonoidAlgebra.coeff P).support,
    w.length < (MonoidAlgebra.coeff P).support.sup (fun w : Word => w.length) + 1
  intro w hw
  exact Nat.lt_succ_of_le (Finset.le_sup hw)

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.binaryLetter_ne_zero
statement: theorem binaryLetter_ne_zero (b : Bool) : binaryLetter F b ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  exact MonoidAlgebra.single_ne_zero.mpr (one_ne_zero : (1 : F) ≠ 0)

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.waitingStem_ne_zero
statement:
theorem waitingStem_ne_zero (n : ℕ) (t : StemWord n → F) (ht : t ≠ 0) :
    waitingStem F n t ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (stemPolynomial_ne_zero F n t ht)
    (binaryLetter_ne_zero F false)) (stemPolynomial_ne_zero F n t ht)

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.waitingStem_homogeneous
statement:
theorem waitingStem_homogeneous (n : ℕ) (t : StemWord n → F) :
    WordHomogeneous (2 * n + 1) (waitingStem F n t)
proof:
:= by
  have hb : WordHomogeneous 1 (binaryLetter F false) := by
    simpa only [binaryLetter, FreeMonoid.length_of] using
      (wordHomogeneous_single (FreeMonoid.of false) (1 : F))
  have h := wordHomogeneous_mul
    (wordHomogeneous_mul (stemPolynomial_homogeneous F n t) hb)
    (stemPolynomial_homogeneous F n t)
  convert h using 1 <;> omega

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.stemPolynomial_waitingCoefficients
statement:
theorem stemPolynomial_waitingCoefficients (n : ℕ) (t : StemWord n → F) :
    stemPolynomial F (2 * n + 1) (waitingCoefficients F n t) = waitingStem F n t
proof:
:=
  stemPolynomial_of_coefficients F _ _ (waitingStem_homogeneous F n t)

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.waitingCoefficients_ne_zero
statement:
theorem waitingCoefficients_ne_zero (n : ℕ) (t : StemWord n → F) (ht : t ≠ 0) :
    waitingCoefficients F n t ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  homogeneous_coefficients_ne_zero F _ _ (waitingStem_homogeneous F n t)
    (waitingStem_ne_zero F n t ht)

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.waitingSpace_le_product
statement:
theorem waitingSpace_le_product (n : ℕ) (t : StemWord n → F) :
    stemSpace F (2 * n + 1) (waitingCoefficients F n t) ≤
      productSpan F (stemSpace F n t) (stemSpace F n t)
proof:
:= by
  apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
  rintro x ⟨b, rfl⟩
  change stemEmbedding F (2 * n + 1) (waitingCoefficients F n t)
    (binaryLetter F b) ∈ _
  rw [stemEmbedding_binaryLetter_eq_prefix_mul, stemPolynomial_waitingCoefficients]
  have hx := mul_mem_productSpan F (physicalBlock_mem_stemSpace F n t false)
    (physicalBlock_mem_stemSpace F n t b)
  simpa only [stemEmbedding_binaryLetter_eq_prefix_mul, waitingStem, mul_assoc] using hx

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.resetSpace_le_blockPower
statement:
theorem resetSpace_le_blockPower (n : ℕ) (t : StemWord n → F)
    (k : ℕ) (u : FreeMonoid Bool) :
    stemSpace F (localResetDegree n k u) (localResetCoefficients F n t k u) ≤
      blockPower F (stemSpace F n t)
        (((k * k + 1) * (k * k + 1) + u.length) + 1)
proof:
:= by
  apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
  rintro x ⟨b, rfl⟩
  change stemEmbedding F (localResetDegree n k u) (localResetCoefficients F n t k u)
    (binaryLetter F b) ∈ _
  rw [stemEmbedding_binaryLetter_eq_prefix_mul, stemPolynomial_localResetCoefficients]
  rw [← localPIBlock_mul_stemBlock_eq_reset_prefix]
  exact mul_mem_productSpan F (localPIBlock_mem_blockPower F n t k u)
    (physicalBlock_mem_stemSpace F n t b)

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.localPIBlock_algHom_eq_zero
statement:
theorem localPIBlock_algHom_eq_zero (C : Type*) [CommRing C] [Algebra F C]
    (n : ℕ) (t : StemWord n → F) (k : ℕ) (u : FreeMonoid Bool)
    (f : WordAlgebra F →ₐ[F] Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) C) :
    f (localPIBlock F n t k u) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hf : f = binaryEvaluation F (Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) C)
      (fun b => f (binaryLetter F b)) := by
    apply freeMonoidAlgebra_hom_ext_letters
    intro b
    simp [binaryEvaluation, binaryLetter]
  rw [hf]
  exact localPIBlock_evaluation_eq_zero F C n t k u _

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.resetSpace_le_matrix_kernel
statement:
theorem resetSpace_le_matrix_kernel (C : Type*) [CommRing C] [Algebra F C]
    (n : ℕ) (t : StemWord n → F) (k : ℕ) (u : FreeMonoid Bool)
    (f : WordAlgebra F →ₐ[F] Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) C) :
    stemSpace F (localResetDegree n k u) (localResetCoefficients F n t k u) ≤
      LinearMap.ker f.toLinearMap
proof:
:= by
  apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
  rintro x ⟨b, rfl⟩
  change f (stemEmbedding F (localResetDegree n k u)
    (localResetCoefficients F n t k u) (binaryLetter F b)) = 0
  rw [stemEmbedding_binaryLetter_eq_prefix_mul, stemPolynomial_localResetCoefficients]
  rw [← localPIBlock_mul_stemBlock_eq_reset_prefix, map_mul,
    localPIBlock_algHom_eq_zero, zero_mul]

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.waiting_dyadic_degree
statement:
theorem waiting_dyadic_degree (h : ℕ) :
    2 * (2 ^ h - 1) + 1 = 2 ^ (h + 1) - 1
proof:
:= by
  have hp : 0 < (2 : ℕ) ^ h := pow_pos (by norm_num) _
  rw [pow_succ]
  omega

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.furtherPositiveLinearMap_homogeneous
statement:
theorem furtherPositiveLinearMap_homogeneous (W : DyadicDualData F)
    (hW : PrimalCoherent F W) (I : TwoSidedIdeal (WordAlgebra F))
    (hEI : allCutTwoSidedIdeal F W hW ≤ I) (n : ℕ) (hn : n ≠ 0)
    (P : homogeneous F n) :
    furtherPositiveLinearMap F W hW I hEI (homogeneousToPositiveQuotient F W hW n hn P) =
      wordIdealQuotientMap F I P.val
proof:
:=
  wordIdealFactorFromAllCut_map F W hW I hEI P.val

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.idealDegreeSpace_eq_map_positiveSubspace
statement:
theorem idealDegreeSpace_eq_map_positiveSubspace (W : DyadicDualData F)
    (hW : PrimalCoherent F W) (I : TwoSidedIdeal (WordAlgebra F))
    (hEI : allCutTwoSidedIdeal F W hW ≤ I) (m : ℕ) :
    idealDegreeSpace F I (m + 1) =
      (positiveDegreeSubspace F W hW m).map (furtherPositiveLinearMap F W hW I hEI)
proof:
:= by
  ext a
  constructor
  · intro ha
    obtain ⟨P, hP, hPa⟩ := Submodule.mem_map.mp ha
    let x : homogeneous F (m + 1) := ⟨P, hP⟩
    refine ⟨homogeneousToPositiveQuotient F W hW (m + 1) (by omega) x, ?_, ?_⟩
    · refine ⟨Submodule.Quotient.mk x, ?_⟩
      exact componentQuotientToPositive_mk F W hW (m + 1) (by omega) x
    · exact (furtherPositiveLinearMap_homogeneous F W hW I hEI (m + 1) (by omega) x).trans hPa
  · rintro ⟨a, ⟨q, rfl⟩, hqa⟩
    obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective
      ((allCutComponent F W (m + 1)).comap (homogeneous F (m + 1)).subtype) q
    rw [← hP, componentQuotientToPositive_mk,
      furtherPositiveLinearMap_homogeneous] at hqa
    exact ⟨P.val, P.property, hqa⟩

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.idealPositiveFiltration_eq_map
statement:
theorem idealPositiveFiltration_eq_map (W : DyadicDualData F)
    (hW : PrimalCoherent F W) (I : TwoSidedIdeal (WordAlgebra F))
    (hEI : allCutTwoSidedIdeal F W hW ≤ I) (N : ℕ) :
    idealPositiveDegreeFiltration F I N =
      (positiveDegreeFiltration F W hW N).map (furtherPositiveLinearMap F W hW I hEI)
proof:
:= by
  induction N with
  | zero => simp [idealPositiveDegreeFiltration, positiveDegreeFiltration]
  | succ N ih =>
      simp only [idealPositiveDegreeFiltration, positiveDegreeFiltration,
        Finset.range_add_one, Finset.sup_insert, Submodule.map_sup]
      rw [idealDegreeSpace_eq_map_positiveSubspace F W hW I hEI N]
      exact congrArg (fun T => (positiveDegreeSubspace F W hW N).map
        (furtherPositiveLinearMap F W hW I hEI) ⊔ T) ih

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.idealPositiveDegreeGrowth_le_original
statement:
theorem idealPositiveDegreeGrowth_le_original (W : DyadicDualData F)
    (hW : PrimalCoherent F W) (I : TwoSidedIdeal (WordAlgebra F))
    (hEI : allCutTwoSidedIdeal F W hW ≤ I) (N : ℕ) :
    idealPositiveDegreeGrowth F I N ≤ positiveDegreeGrowth F W hW N
proof:
:= by
  unfold idealPositiveDegreeGrowth
  rw [idealPositiveFiltration_eq_map F W hW I hEI N]
  exact Submodule.finrank_map_le (furtherPositiveLinearMap F W hW I hEI)
    (positiveDegreeFiltration F W hW N)

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.furtherQuotient_upper_exponents
statement:
theorem furtherQuotient_upper_exponents (Λ : ℕ → ℝ) (hΛ : EnvelopeDiverges Λ)
    (I : TwoSidedIdeal (WordAlgebra F))
    (hEI : allCutTwoSidedIdeal F (sparseDualData F Λ hΛ)
      (sparseDualData_primalCoherent F Λ hΛ) ≤ I) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    2 + ε ∈ CriticalGK2.Growth.UpperExponentSet (idealPositiveDegreeGrowth F I)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C, hC, hu⟩ := sparseDegreeGrowth_near_two_upper F Λ hΛ ε hε
  refine ⟨C, hC, ?_⟩
  intro n hn
  have h : idealPositiveDegreeGrowth F I n ≤ sparseDegreeGrowth F Λ hΛ n :=
    idealPositiveDegreeGrowth_le_original F _ _ I hEI n
  have hr : (idealPositiveDegreeGrowth F I n : ℝ) ≤ (sparseDegreeGrowth F Λ hΛ n : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast h
  exact hr.trans (hu n hn)

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.furtherQuotient_logarithmic_limit
statement:
theorem furtherQuotient_logarithmic_limit (Λ : ℕ → ℝ) (hΛ : EnvelopeDiverges Λ)
    (I : TwoSidedIdeal (WordAlgebra F))
    (hEI : allCutTwoSidedIdeal F (sparseDualData F Λ hΛ)
      (sparseDualData_primalCoherent F Λ hΛ) ≤ I)
    (hhom : WordIdealHomogeneous F I) (htail : NoWordTail F I) :
    Tendsto (CriticalGK2.Growth.logarithmicGrowthRatio (idealPositiveDegreeGrowth F I))
      atTop (𝓝 2)
proof:
:= by
  apply CriticalGK2.Growth.tendsto_logarithmicGrowthRatio_two
  · intro n _
    have h := sparse_furtherQuotient_growth_quadratic_lower F Λ hΛ I hEI hhom htail n
    have hs : n ^ 2 ≤ n * (n + 3) := by
      rw [Nat.pow_two]
      exact Nat.mul_le_mul_left n (Nat.le_add_right n 3)
    exact_mod_cast hs.trans h
  · exact furtherQuotient_upper_exponents F Λ hΛ I hEI

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.furtherQuotient_envelope_upper
statement:
theorem furtherQuotient_envelope_upper (Λ : ℕ → ℝ) (hΛ : EnvelopeDiverges Λ)
    (hmono : Monotone Λ) (hone : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → 1 ≤ Λ n)
    (I : TwoSidedIdeal (WordAlgebra F))
    (hEI : allCutTwoSidedIdeal F (sparseDualData F Λ hΛ)
      (sparseDualData_primalCoherent F Λ hΛ) ≤ I) (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) :
    (idealPositiveDegreeGrowth F I n : ℝ) ≤ 4 * ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 * Λ n
proof:
:= by
  have h : idealPositiveDegreeGrowth F I n ≤ sparseDegreeGrowth F Λ hΛ n :=
    idealPositiveDegreeGrowth_le_original F _ _ I hEI n
  have hr : (idealPositiveDegreeGrowth F I n : ℝ) ≤ (sparseDegreeGrowth F Λ hΛ n : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast h
  exact hr.trans (sparseDegreeGrowth_envelope_upper F Λ hΛ hmono hone n hn)

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.allCutSubmodule_mul_degreeOne
statement:
theorem allCutSubmodule_mul_degreeOne (W : DyadicDualData F)
    (hW : PrimalCoherent F W) {x y : WordAlgebra F}
    (hx : x ∈ allCutSubmodule F W) (hy : y ∈ homogeneous F 1) :
    x * y ∈ allCutSubmodule F W
proof:
:= by
  have hle : allCutSubmodule F W ≤
      (allCutSubmodule F W).comap (rightMultiplication F y) := by
    apply iSup_le
    intro n z hz
    have hzy := allCutComponent_mul_letter F W hW (n + 1)
      (mul_mem_productSpan F hz hy)
    exact (le_iSup (fun m => allCutComponent F W (m + 1)) (n + 1)) hzy
  exact hle hx

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.degreeOne_mul_allCutSubmodule
statement:
theorem degreeOne_mul_allCutSubmodule (W : DyadicDualData F)
    (hW : PrimalCoherent F W) {x y : WordAlgebra F}
    (hx : x ∈ homogeneous F 1) (hy : y ∈ allCutSubmodule F W) :
    x * y ∈ allCutSubmodule F W
proof:
:= by
  have hle : allCutSubmodule F W ≤
      (allCutSubmodule F W).comap (leftMultiplication F x) := by
    apply iSup_le
    intro n z hz
    have hxz := letter_mul_allCutComponent F W hW (n + 1)
      (mul_mem_productSpan F hx hz)
    exact (le_iSup (fun m => allCutComponent F W (m + 1)) (n + 1)) hxz
  exact hle hy

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.monomialOne_mul_allCutSubmodule
statement:
theorem monomialOne_mul_allCutSubmodule (W : DyadicDualData F)
    (hW : PrimalCoherent F W) (w : Word) :
    ∀ x : WordAlgebra F, x ∈ allCutSubmodule F W →
      MonoidAlgebra.single w 1 * x ∈ allCutSubmodule F W
proof:
:= by
  refine FreeMonoid.recOn w ?_ ?_
  ·
      intro x hx
      simpa only [← MonoidAlgebra.one_def, one_mul] using hx
  ·
      intro b w ih x hx
      have hletter : MonoidAlgebra.single (FreeMonoid.of b) (1 : F) ∈ homogeneous F 1 :=
        monomial_mem_homogeneous F 1 ⟨FreeMonoid.of b, FreeMonoid.length_of b⟩ 1
      have h := degreeOne_mul_allCutSubmodule F W hW hletter (ih x hx)
      simpa only [← mul_assoc, MonoidAlgebra.single_mul_single, one_mul] using h

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.allCutSubmodule_mul_monomialOne
statement:
theorem allCutSubmodule_mul_monomialOne (W : DyadicDualData F)
    (hW : PrimalCoherent F W) (w : Word) :
    ∀ x : WordAlgebra F, x ∈ allCutSubmodule F W →
      x * MonoidAlgebra.single w 1 ∈ allCutSubmodule F W
proof:
:= by
  refine FreeMonoid.recOn w ?_ ?_
  ·
      intro x hx
      simpa only [← MonoidAlgebra.one_def, mul_one] using hx
  ·
      intro b w ih x hx
      have hletter : MonoidAlgebra.single (FreeMonoid.of b) (1 : F) ∈ homogeneous F 1 :=
        monomial_mem_homogeneous F 1 ⟨FreeMonoid.of b, FreeMonoid.length_of b⟩ 1
      have hstep := allCutSubmodule_mul_degreeOne F W hW hx hletter
      have h := ih (x * MonoidAlgebra.single (FreeMonoid.of b) 1) hstep
      simpa only [mul_assoc, MonoidAlgebra.single_mul_single, one_mul] using h

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.allCutSubmodule_mul_mem_left
statement:
theorem allCutSubmodule_mul_mem_left (W : DyadicDualData F)
    (hW : PrimalCoherent F W) (a x : WordAlgebra F)
    (hx : x ∈ allCutSubmodule F W) : a * x ∈ allCutSubmodule F W
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction a using Finsupp.induction with
  | zero =>
      change (0 : WordAlgebra F) * x ∈ allCutSubmodule F W
      rw [zero_mul]
      exact (allCutSubmodule F W).zero_mem
  | single_add w c a hwa hc ih =>
      change (MonoidAlgebra.single w c + MonoidAlgebra.ofCoeff a) * x ∈ allCutSubmodule F W
      rw [add_mul]
      apply (allCutSubmodule F W).add_mem _ ih
      have hsingle : MonoidAlgebra.single w c = c • MonoidAlgebra.single w (1 : F) := by
        simp [MonoidAlgebra.single, Finsupp.smul_single]
      rw [hsingle, smul_mul_assoc]
      exact (allCutSubmodule F W).smul_mem c
        (monomialOne_mul_allCutSubmodule F W hW w x hx)

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.allCutSubmodule_mul_mem_right
statement:
theorem allCutSubmodule_mul_mem_right (W : DyadicDualData F)
    (hW : PrimalCoherent F W) (x a : WordAlgebra F)
    (hx : x ∈ allCutSubmodule F W) : x * a ∈ allCutSubmodule F W
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction a using Finsupp.induction with
  | zero =>
      change x * (0 : WordAlgebra F) ∈ allCutSubmodule F W
      rw [mul_zero]
      exact (allCutSubmodule F W).zero_mem
  | single_add w c a hwa hc ih =>
      change x * (MonoidAlgebra.single w c + MonoidAlgebra.ofCoeff a) ∈ allCutSubmodule F W
      rw [mul_add]
      apply (allCutSubmodule F W).add_mem _ ih
      have hsingle : MonoidAlgebra.single w c = c • MonoidAlgebra.single w (1 : F) := by
        simp [MonoidAlgebra.single, Finsupp.smul_single]
      rw [hsingle, mul_smul_comm]
      exact (allCutSubmodule F W).smul_mem c
        (allCutSubmodule_mul_monomialOne F W hW w x hx)

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.mem_allCutTwoSidedIdeal
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_allCutTwoSidedIdeal (W : DyadicDualData F) (hW : PrimalCoherent F W)
    (x : WordAlgebra F) :
    x ∈ allCutTwoSidedIdeal F W hW ↔ x ∈ allCutSubmodule F W
proof:
:= by
  simp [allCutTwoSidedIdeal]

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.blockPower_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem blockPower_zero (S : Submodule F (WordAlgebra F)) :
    blockPower F S 0 = homogeneous F 0
proof: := rfl

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.blockPower_succ
statement:
@[simp] theorem blockPower_succ (S : Submodule F (WordAlgebra F)) (m : ℕ) :
    blockPower F S (m + 1) = productSpan F (blockPower F S m) S
proof: := rfl

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.blockPower_one
statement:
@[simp] theorem blockPower_one (S : Submodule F (WordAlgebra F)) :
    blockPower F S 1 = S
proof:
:= by
  rw [blockPower_succ, blockPower_zero, productSpan_homogeneous_zero_left]

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.productSpan_blockPower
statement:
theorem productSpan_blockPower (S : Submodule F (WordAlgebra F)) (m n : ℕ) :
    productSpan F (blockPower F S m) (blockPower F S n) = blockPower F S (m + n)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [productSpan_homogeneous_zero_right]
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [blockPower_succ, ← productSpan_assoc, ih]
      rfl

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.blockPower_le_homogeneous
statement:
theorem blockPower_le_homogeneous (S : Submodule F (WordAlgebra F))
    (q : ℕ) (hS : S ≤ homogeneous F q) (m : ℕ) :
    blockPower F S m ≤ homogeneous F (m * q)
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero => simp
  | succ m ih =>
      have h := productSpan_mono F ih hS
      simpa only [blockPower_succ, homogeneous_productSpan, Nat.succ_mul] using h

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.pow_mem_blockPower
statement:
theorem pow_mem_blockPower (S : Submodule F (WordAlgebra F))
    (x : WordAlgebra F) (hx : x ∈ S) (m : ℕ) : x ^ m ∈ blockPower F S m
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero =>
      rw [pow_zero, blockPower_zero, homogeneous_zero_eq_span_one]
      exact Submodule.subset_span (by simp)
  | succ m ih =>
      rw [pow_succ, blockPower_succ]
      exact mul_mem_productSpan F ih hx

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.blockPower_ne_bot
statement:
theorem blockPower_ne_bot (S : Submodule F (WordAlgebra F))
    (x : WordAlgebra F) (hx : x ∈ S) (hne : x ≠ 0) (m : ℕ) :
    blockPower F S m ≠ ⊥
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hm := pow_mem_blockPower F S x hx m
  rw [h] at hm
  exact (pow_ne_zero m hne) ((Submodule.mem_bot F).mp hm)

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.physicalBlock_mem_stemSpace
statement:
theorem physicalBlock_mem_stemSpace (n : ℕ) (t : StemWord n → F) (b : Bool) :
    stemEmbedding F n t (binaryLetter F b) ∈ stemSpace F n t
proof:
:=
  Submodule.subset_span ⟨b, rfl⟩

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.wordHomogeneous_mem_homogeneous
statement:
theorem wordHomogeneous_mem_homogeneous (n : ℕ) (x : WordAlgebra F)
    (hx : WordHomogeneous n x) : x ∈ homogeneous F n
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_homogeneous_iff]
  intro w hw
  by_contra h
  exact hw (hx w h)

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.stemSpace_le_homogeneous
statement:
theorem stemSpace_le_homogeneous (n : ℕ) (t : StemWord n → F) :
    stemSpace F n t ≤ homogeneous F (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
  rintro x ⟨b, rfl⟩
  exact wordHomogeneous_mem_homogeneous F _ _
    (stemEmbedding_binaryLetter_homogeneous F n t b)

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.stemSpace_ne_bot
statement:
theorem stemSpace_ne_bot (n : ℕ) (t : StemWord n → F) (ht : t ≠ 0) :
    stemSpace F n t ≠ ⊥
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hx := physicalBlock_mem_stemSpace F n t false
  rw [h] at hx
  have hzero := (Submodule.mem_bot F).mp hx
  have hinj := stemEmbedding_injective F n t ht
  have hletter : binaryLetter F false = 0 := hinj (by simpa using hzero)
  exact (MonoidAlgebra.single_ne_zero.mpr (one_ne_zero : (1 : F) ≠ 0)) hletter

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.physicalBlockProduct_mem_blockPower
statement:
theorem physicalBlockProduct_mem_blockPower (n : ℕ) (t : StemWord n → F)
    (w : FreeMonoid Bool) :
    physicalBlockProduct F n t w ∈ blockPower F (stemSpace F n t) w.length
proof:
:= by
  refine FreeMonoid.recOn w ?_ ?_
  · change (1 : WordAlgebra F) ∈ blockPower F (stemSpace F n t) 0
    simpa using pow_mem_blockPower F (stemSpace F n t)
      (stemEmbedding F n t (binaryLetter F false))
      (physicalBlock_mem_stemSpace F n t false) 0
  · intro b w ih
    have hprod := mul_mem_productSpan F (physicalBlock_mem_stemSpace F n t b) ih
    have hprod' :
        stemEmbedding F n t (binaryLetter F b) * physicalBlockProduct F n t w ∈
          productSpan F (blockPower F (stemSpace F n t) 1)
            (blockPower F (stemSpace F n t) w.length) := by
      simpa only [blockPower_one] using hprod
    rw [productSpan_blockPower] at hprod'
    simpa [physicalBlockProduct, FreeMonoid.toList_mul, FreeMonoid.length_mul,
      FreeMonoid.length_of, Nat.add_comm] using hprod'

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.repeatedBlockSpace_le_blockPower
statement:
theorem repeatedBlockSpace_le_blockPower (n : ℕ) (t : StemWord n → F) (m : ℕ) :
    repeatedBlockSpace F n t m ≤ blockPower F (stemSpace F n t) m
proof:
:= by
  apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
  rintro x ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
  simpa only [hw] using physicalBlockProduct_mem_blockPower F n t w

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.localPIBlock_mem_blockPower
statement:
theorem localPIBlock_mem_blockPower (n : ℕ) (t : StemWord n → F)
    (k : ℕ) (u : FreeMonoid Bool) :
    localPIBlock F n t k u ∈
      blockPower F (stemSpace F n t) ((k * k + 1) * (k * k + 1) + u.length)
proof:
:=
  repeatedBlockSpace_le_blockPower F n t _
    (localPIBlock_mem_repeatedBlockSpace F n t k u)

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.target_supportBudget_monotone
statement: theorem target_supportBudget_monotone : Monotone (supportBudget targetCost)
proof:
:= by
  apply monotone_nat_of_le_succ
  intro j
  have hp : 1 ≤ (2 : ℕ) ^ targetCost j :=
    Nat.succ_le_iff.mpr (pow_pos (by omega) _)
  change supportBudget targetCost j ≤ 2 ^ targetCost j * supportBudget targetCost j
  simpa only [one_mul] using Nat.mul_le_mul_right (supportBudget targetCost j) hp

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.scheduledHeight_index_le
statement:
theorem scheduledHeight_index_le (Λ : ℕ → ℝ) (hΛ : EnvelopeDiverges Λ) (j : ℕ) :
    j ≤ scheduledHeight Λ hΛ j
proof:
:= by
  induction j with
  | zero => exact Nat.zero_le _
  | succ j ih =>
      have h := scheduledHeight_separated Λ hΛ j
      omega

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.scheduledHeight_monotone
statement:
theorem scheduledHeight_monotone (Λ : ℕ → ℝ) (hΛ : EnvelopeDiverges Λ) :
    Monotone (scheduledHeight Λ hΛ)
proof:
:=
  (scaleHeight_strictMono targetCost targetDuration Λ hΛ).monotone

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.exists_scheduledHeight_above
statement:
theorem exists_scheduledHeight_above (Λ : ℕ → ℝ) (hΛ : EnvelopeDiverges Λ) (H : ℕ) :
    ∃ j : ℕ, H ≤ scheduledHeight Λ hΛ j
proof:
:=
  ⟨H, scheduledHeight_index_le Λ hΛ H⟩

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.begunOperationCount_upper
statement:
theorem begunOperationCount_upper (Λ : ℕ → ℝ) (hΛ : EnvelopeDiverges Λ) (H : ℕ) :
    H ≤ scheduledHeight Λ hΛ (begunOperationCount Λ hΛ H)
proof:
:=
  Nat.find_spec (exists_scheduledHeight_above Λ hΛ H)

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.begunOperationCount_minimal
statement:
theorem begunOperationCount_minimal (Λ : ℕ → ℝ) (hΛ : EnvelopeDiverges Λ)
    (H j : ℕ) (hj : j < begunOperationCount Λ hΛ H) :
    scheduledHeight Λ hΛ j < H
proof:
:=
  Nat.lt_of_not_ge (Nat.find_min (exists_scheduledHeight_above Λ hΛ H) hj)

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.begunOperationCount_mono
statement:
theorem begunOperationCount_mono (Λ : ℕ → ℝ) (hΛ : EnvelopeDiverges Λ) :
    Monotone (begunOperationCount Λ hΛ)
proof:
:= by
  intro H T hHT
  exact Nat.find_min' (exists_scheduledHeight_above Λ hΛ H)
    (hHT.trans (begunOperationCount_upper Λ hΛ T))

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.begunOperationCount_gt_of_height
statement:
theorem begunOperationCount_gt_of_height (Λ : ℕ → ℝ) (hΛ : EnvelopeDiverges Λ)
    (H j : ℕ) (hj : scheduledHeight Λ hΛ j < H) :
    j < begunOperationCount Λ hΛ H
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  have hle : begunOperationCount Λ hΛ H ≤ j := by omega
  have hh := scheduledHeight_monotone Λ hΛ hle
  have hu := begunOperationCount_upper Λ hΛ H
  omega

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.root_operation_budget_power_le_degree
statement:
theorem root_operation_budget_power_le_degree (Λ : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hΛ : EnvelopeDiverges Λ) (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) :
    supportBudget targetCost (begunOperationCount Λ hΛ (strictDyadicRoot n)) ^
      begunOperationCount Λ hΛ (strictDyadicRoot n) ≤ n
proof:
:= by
  let j := begunOperationCount Λ hΛ (strictDyadicRoot n)
  change supportBudget targetCost j ^ j ≤ n
  by_cases hj : j = 0
  · simp only [hj, pow_zero]
    omega
  · have hpred : j - 1 < begunOperationCount Λ hΛ (strictDyadicRoot n) := by
      change j - 1 < j
      omega
    have hheight := begunOperationCount_minimal Λ hΛ (strictDyadicRoot n) (j - 1) hpred
    have he : j - 1 + 1 = j := by omega
    have hcost := scaleHeight_budget_pow targetCost targetDuration Λ hΛ (j - 1)
    change supportBudget targetCost (j - 1 + 1) ^ (j - 1 + 1) ≤
      2 ^ scheduledHeight Λ hΛ (j - 1) at hcost
    rw [he] at hcost
    have hh : scheduledHeight Λ hΛ (j - 1) ≤ Nat.log 2 n := by
      dsimp only [strictDyadicRoot] at hheight
      omega
    exact hcost.trans ((Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega : 0 < (2 : ℕ)) hh).trans
      (Nat.pow_log_le_self 2 (Nat.ne_of_gt hn)))

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.root_operation_count_ge_after_threshold
statement:
theorem root_operation_count_ge_after_threshold (Λ : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hΛ : EnvelopeDiverges Λ) (J n : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J)
    (hn : 2 ^ scheduledHeight Λ hΛ (J - 1) ≤ n) :
    J ≤ begunOperationCount Λ hΛ (strictDyadicRoot n)
proof:
:= by
  have hroot := strictDyadicRoot_monotone hn
  rw [strictDyadicRoot_two_pow] at hroot
  have hj : scheduledHeight Λ hΛ (J - 1) < strictDyadicRoot n := by omega
  have hcount := begunOperationCount_gt_of_height Λ hΛ (strictDyadicRoot n) (J - 1) hj
  omega

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.rightCompletion_le_homogeneous
statement:
theorem rightCompletion_le_homogeneous (W : DyadicDualData F) (n : ℕ) :
    rightCompletion F W n ≤ homogeneous F n
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hn : n = 0
  · simp [rightCompletion, hn]
  · simp only [rightCompletion, if_neg hn]
    exact inf_le_left

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.leftCompletion_le_homogeneous
statement:
theorem leftCompletion_le_homogeneous (W : DyadicDualData F) (n : ℕ) :
    leftCompletion F W n ≤ homogeneous F n
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hn : n = 0
  · simp [leftCompletion, hn]
  · simp only [leftCompletion, if_neg hn]
    exact inf_le_left

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.rightCompletion_root_product
statement:
theorem rightCompletion_root_product (W : DyadicDualData F) (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) :
    productSpan F (rightCompletion F W n)
      (homogeneous F (2 ^ strictDyadicRoot n - n)) ≤
        ambientAnnihilator F W (strictDyadicRoot n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [productSpan_le_iff]
  intro x hx y hy
  have hx' : x ∈ homogeneous F n ∧
      ∀ b : homogeneous F (2 ^ strictDyadicRoot n - n),
        x * b.val ∈ ambientAnnihilator F W (strictDyadicRoot n) := by
    simpa only [rightCompletion, if_neg (Nat.ne_of_gt hn), Submodule.mem_inf,
      Submodule.mem_iInf, Submodule.mem_comap, rightMultiplication] using hx
  exact hx'.2 ⟨y, hy⟩

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.leftCompletion_root_product
statement:
theorem leftCompletion_root_product (W : DyadicDualData F) (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) :
    productSpan F (homogeneous F (2 ^ strictDyadicRoot n - n))
      (leftCompletion F W n) ≤
        ambientAnnihilator F W (strictDyadicRoot n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [productSpan_le_iff]
  intro x hx y hy
  have hy' : y ∈ homogeneous F n ∧
      ∀ a : homogeneous F (2 ^ strictDyadicRoot n - n),
        a.val * y ∈ ambientAnnihilator F W (strictDyadicRoot n) := by
    simpa only [leftCompletion, if_neg (Nat.ne_of_gt hn), Submodule.mem_inf,
      Submodule.mem_iInf, Submodule.mem_comap, leftMultiplication] using hy
  exact hy'.2 ⟨x, hx⟩

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.rightCompletion_extension
statement:
theorem rightCompletion_extension (W : DyadicDualData F)
    (hW : PrimalCoherent F W) (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n)
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : strictDyadicRoot n ≤ J) :
    productSpan F (rightCompletion F W n) (homogeneous F (2 ^ J - n)) ≤
      ambientAnnihilator F W J
proof:
:= by
  induction J, hJ using Nat.le_induction with
  | base => exact rightCompletion_root_product F W n hn
  | succ J hJ ih =>
      have hpow : 2 ^ strictDyadicRoot n ≤ (2 : ℕ) ^ J := by gcongr <;> norm_num
      have hnJ : n ≤ 2 ^ J :=
        Nat.le_of_lt ((lt_strictDyadicRoot_pow n).trans_le hpow)
      have hgap : (2 ^ J - n) + 2 ^ J = 2 ^ (J + 1) - n := by
        rw [pow_succ]
        omega
      calc
        productSpan F (rightCompletion F W n) (homogeneous F (2 ^ (J + 1) - n))
          = productSpan F (rightCompletion F W n)
              (productSpan F (homogeneous F (2 ^ J - n)) (homogeneous F (2 ^ J))) := by
                  rw [homogeneous_productSpan, hgap]
        _ = productSpan F
              (productSpan F (rightCompletion F W n) (homogeneous F (2 ^ J - n)))
              (homogeneous F (2 ^ J)) := (productSpan_assoc F _ _ _).symm
        _ ≤ productSpan F (ambientAnnihilator F W J) (homogeneous F (2 ^ J)) :=
              productSpan_mono F ih le_rfl
        _ ≤ ambientAnnihilator F W (J + 1) := (le_sup_left.trans (hW J))

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.leftCompletion_extension
statement:
theorem leftCompletion_extension (W : DyadicDualData F)
    (hW : PrimalCoherent F W) (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n)
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : strictDyadicRoot n ≤ J) :
    productSpan F (homogeneous F (2 ^ J - n)) (leftCompletion F W n) ≤
      ambientAnnihilator F W J
proof:
:= by
  induction J, hJ using Nat.le_induction with
  | base => exact leftCompletion_root_product F W n hn
  | succ J hJ ih =>
      have hpow : 2 ^ strictDyadicRoot n ≤ (2 : ℕ) ^ J := by gcongr <;> norm_num
      have hnJ : n ≤ 2 ^ J :=
        Nat.le_of_lt ((lt_strictDyadicRoot_pow n).trans_le hpow)
      have hgap : 2 ^ J + (2 ^ J - n) = 2 ^ (J + 1) - n := by
        rw [pow_succ]
        omega
      calc
        productSpan F (homogeneous F (2 ^ (J + 1) - n)) (leftCompletion F W n)
          = productSpan F
              (productSpan F (homogeneous F (2 ^ J)) (homogeneous F (2 ^ J - n)))
              (leftCompletion F W n) := by rw [homogeneous_productSpan, hgap]
        _ = productSpan F (homogeneous F (2 ^ J))
              (productSpan F (homogeneous F (2 ^ J - n)) (leftCompletion F W n)) :=
                productSpan_assoc F _ _ _
        _ ≤ productSpan F (homogeneous F (2 ^ J)) (ambientAnnihilator F W J) :=
              productSpan_mono F le_rfl ih
        _ ≤ ambientAnnihilator F W (J + 1) := (le_sup_right.trans (hW J))

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.actualDualSpaceCut_finrank
statement:
theorem actualDualSpaceCut_finrank (n a b : ℕ) (hab : a + b = n)
    (W : Submodule F (HomogeneousDual F n)) :
    Module.finrank F (actualDualSpaceCut F n a b hab W) = Module.finrank F W
proof:
:=
  (actualDualSpaceCutMap F n a b hab).finrank_map_eq W

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.actualDualCutBound_mono
statement:
theorem actualDualCutBound_mono (n : ℕ) {S T : Submodule F (HomogeneousDual F n)}
    (hST : S ≤ T) (B : ℕ) (hT : ActualDualCutBound F n T B) : ActualDualCutBound F n S B
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro a b hab
  letI : FiniteDimensional F (HomogeneousDual F a) :=
    (homogeneousWordBasis F a).dualBasis.finiteDimensional_of_finite
  letI : FiniteDimensional F (HomogeneousDual F b) :=
    (homogeneousWordBasis F b).dualBasis.finiteDimensional_of_finite
  have hc : actualDualSpaceCut F n a b hab S ≤ actualDualSpaceCut F n a b hab T :=
    Submodule.map_mono hST
  exact ⟨(Submodule.finrank_mono (tensorPrefixSupport_mono hc)).trans (hT a b hab).1,
    (Submodule.finrank_mono (tensorSuffixSupport_mono hc)).trans (hT a b hab).2⟩

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.actualDualCutBound_budget_mono
statement:
theorem actualDualCutBound_budget_mono (n : ℕ) (W : Submodule F (HomogeneousDual F n))
    {B C : ℕ} (hBC : B ≤ C) (hB : ActualDualCutBound F n W B) : ActualDualCutBound F n W C
proof:
:=
  fun a b hab => ⟨(hB a b hab).1.trans hBC, (hB a b hab).2.trans hBC⟩

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.actualDualCutBound_degreeCast
statement:
theorem actualDualCutBound_degreeCast {n m : ℕ} (h : n = m)
    (W : Submodule F (HomogeneousDual F n)) (B : ℕ) (hB : ActualDualCutBound F n W B) :
    ActualDualCutBound F m (W.map (homogeneousDualDegreeCast F h).toLinearMap) B
proof:
:= by
  subst m
  simpa only [homogeneousDualDegreeCast, LinearEquiv.refl_toLinearMap, Submodule.map_id] using hB

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.actualDualSpaceCut_stem_inside
statement:
theorem actualDualSpaceCut_stem_inside (a b : ℕ) (P : WordAlgebra F) :
    actualDualSpaceCut F ((a + b) + 1) a (b + 1) (Nat.add_assoc a b 1).symm
      (actualStemDualSpace F (a + b) P) = actualStemInsideCutSpace F a b P
proof:
:= by
  change (actualStemDualSpace F (a + b) P).map
    ((homogeneousDualTensorConcat F a (b + 1)).symm.toLinearMap.comp
      (homogeneousDualDegreeCast F (Nat.add_assoc a b 1).symm).symm.toLinearMap) = _
  rw [homogeneousDualDegreeCast_symm_eq F (Nat.add_assoc a b 1), LinearEquiv.symm_symm]
  rfl

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.actualStemDualSpace_cutBound
statement:
theorem actualStemDualSpace_cutBound (q : ℕ) (P : WordAlgebra F)
    (hP : P ∈ homogeneous F q) (hP0 : P ≠ 0) :
    ActualDualCutBound F (q + 1) (actualStemDualSpace F q P)
      (2 * polynomialCutBudget F q P)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro a b hab
  by_cases ha : a ≤ q
  · obtain ⟨c, hq⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le ha
    have hb : b = c + 1 := by omega
    subst q
    subst b
    have hc : actualDualSpaceCut F ((a + c) + 1) a (c + 1) hab
        (actualStemDualSpace F (a + c) P) = actualStemInsideCutSpace F a c P :=
      actualDualSpaceCut_stem_inside F a c P
    rw [hc, actualStemInsideCut_prefixSupport_finrank, actualStemInsideCut_suffixSupport_finrank]
    have hr := (polynomialCutBudget_le_iff F (a + c) P _).mp le_rfl a c rfl
    constructor <;> omega
  · have ha0 : a = q + 1 := by omega
    have hb0 : b = 0 := by omega
    subst a
    subst b
    letI : FiniteDimensional F (HomogeneousDual F (q + 1)) :=
      (homogeneousWordBasis F (q + 1)).dualBasis.finiteDimensional_of_finite
    letI : FiniteDimensional F (HomogeneousDual F 0) :=
      (homogeneousWordBasis F 0).dualBasis.finiteDimensional_of_finite
    have hdim : Module.finrank F (actualDualSpaceCut F (q + 1) (q + 1) 0 hab
        (actualStemDualSpace F q P)) = 2 :=
      (actualDualSpaceCut_finrank F _ _ _ hab _).trans
        (actualStemDualSpace_finrank F q P hP hP0)
    have hzero : Module.finrank F (HomogeneousDual F 0) = 1 := by
      rw [← (coefficientSelfDual F 0).finrank_eq, finrank_homogeneous_zero]
    have hpos := polynomialCutBudget_pos F q P hP hP0
    constructor
    · calc
        _ ≤ Module.finrank F (actualDualSpaceCut F (q + 1) (q + 1) 0 hab
              (actualStemDualSpace F q P)) * Module.finrank F (HomogeneousDual F 0) :=
          tensorPrefixSupport_finrank_le _
        _ = 2 := by rw [hdim, hzero]
        _ ≤ 2 * polynomialCutBudget F q P := by omega
    · calc
        _ ≤ Module.finrank F (HomogeneousDual F 0) := by
          simpa only [finrank_top] using Submodule.finrank_mono
            (show tensorSuffixSupport (actualDualSpaceCut F (q + 1) (q + 1) 0 hab
              (actualStemDualSpace F q P)) ≤ ⊤ from le_top)
        _ = 1 := hzero
        _ ≤ 2 * polynomialCutBudget F q P := by omega

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.prefixSpace_dualCoefficientSpace_eq_actualStemDualSpace
statement:
theorem prefixSpace_dualCoefficientSpace_eq_actualStemDualSpace
    (q : ℕ) (P : WordAlgebra F) (hP : WordHomogeneous q P) :
    dualCoefficientSpace F (q + 1) (prefixSpace F P) = actualStemDualSpace F q P
proof:
:= by
  let t : StemWord q → F := fun a => P (FreeMonoid.ofList (List.ofFn a))
  have hread : stemPolynomial F q t = P := stemPolynomial_of_coefficients F q P hP
  have h := stemSpace_dualCoefficientSpace_eq_actualStemDualSpace F q t
  rw [stemSpace_eq_prefixSpace, hread] at h
  exact h

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.actualStemCutBudget_le_of_cutBound
statement:
theorem actualStemCutBudget_le_of_cutBound (q : ℕ) (P : WordAlgebra F)
    (hP : P ∈ homogeneous F q) (hP0 : P ≠ 0) (B : ℕ)
    (hB : ActualDualCutBound F (q + 1) (actualStemDualSpace F q P) B) :
    actualStemCutBudget F q P ≤ B
proof:
:= by
  rw [actualStemCutBudget_eq_twice F q P hP hP0]
  unfold polynomialCutBudget
  rw [← finset_sup_twice]
  apply Finset.sup_le
  intro a ha
  have haq : a ≤ q := by have := Finset.mem_range.mp ha; omega
  obtain ⟨b, hq⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le haq
  subst q
  have hs := (hB a (b + 1) (Nat.add_assoc a b 1).symm).2
  rw [actualDualSpaceCut_stem_inside, actualStemInsideCut_suffixSupport_finrank] at hs
  simpa only [Nat.add_sub_cancel_left] using hs

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.prefixState_actualDualCutBound
statement:
theorem prefixState_actualDualCutBound (P : PrefixState F) :
    ActualDualCutBound F (2 ^ P.height)
      (dualCoefficientSpace F (2 ^ P.height) (prefixSpace F P.polynomial))
        (prefixStateCutBudget F P)
proof:
:= by
  have hP : P.polynomial ∈ homogeneous F (2 ^ P.height - 1) :=
    (wordHomogeneous_iff_mem_homogeneous F _ _).mp P.homogeneous
  have hq : (2 ^ P.height - 1) + 1 = 2 ^ P.height := by
    have hp : 0 < (2 : ℕ) ^ P.height := pow_pos (by norm_num) _
    omega
  have hB : ActualDualCutBound F ((2 ^ P.height - 1) + 1)
      (dualCoefficientSpace F ((2 ^ P.height - 1) + 1) (prefixSpace F P.polynomial))
        (prefixStateCutBudget F P) := by
    rw [prefixSpace_dualCoefficientSpace_eq_actualStemDualSpace F _ _ P.homogeneous]
    change ActualDualCutBound F _ _ (actualStemCutBudget F _ _)
    rw [actualStemCutBudget_eq_twice F _ _ hP P.nonzero]
    exact actualStemDualSpace_cutBound F _ _ hP P.nonzero
  rw [dualCoefficientSpace_degreeCast F hq]
  exact actualDualCutBound_degreeCast F hq _ _ hB

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.waitPrefix_cutBudget
statement:
theorem waitPrefix_cutBudget (P : PrefixState F) :
    prefixStateCutBudget F (waitPrefix F P) = prefixStateCutBudget F P
proof:
:= by
  unfold prefixStateCutBudget
  rw [waitPrefix_height, ← waiting_dyadic_degree]
  exact actualStemCutBudget_waiting F _ P.polynomial
    ((wordHomogeneous_iff_mem_homogeneous F _ _).mp P.homogeneous) P.nonzero

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.waitIter_cutBudget
statement:
theorem waitIter_cutBudget (P : PrefixState F) (w : ℕ) :
    prefixStateCutBudget F (waitIter F P w) = prefixStateCutBudget F P
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ w ih => rw [waitIter_succ, waitPrefix_cutBudget, ih]

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.initialPrefix_cutBudget
statement: theorem initialPrefix_cutBudget : prefixStateCutBudget F (initialPrefix F) = 2
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (1 : WordAlgebra F) ∈ homogeneous F 0 := by
    rw [homogeneous_zero_eq_span_one]
    exact Submodule.subset_span (by simp)
  change actualStemCutBudget F 0 (1 : WordAlgebra F) = 2
  rw [actualStemCutBudget_eq_twice F 0 1 h1 one_ne_zero]
  have hrho : polynomialCutBudget F 0 (1 : WordAlgebra F) = 1 := by
    simp only [polynomialCutBudget, Nat.zero_add, Finset.range_one, Finset.sup_singleton,
      Nat.sub_zero]
    exact polynomialCutRank_zero F 0 1 h1 one_ne_zero
  rw [hrho]

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.prefixStateCutBudget_le_of_cutBound
statement:
theorem prefixStateCutBudget_le_of_cutBound (P : PrefixState F) (B : ℕ)
    (hB : ActualDualCutBound F (2 ^ P.height)
      (dualCoefficientSpace F (2 ^ P.height) (prefixSpace F P.polynomial)) B) :
    prefixStateCutBudget F P ≤ B
proof:
:= by
  have hq : (2 ^ P.height - 1) + 1 = 2 ^ P.height := by
    have hp : 0 < (2 : ℕ) ^ P.height := pow_pos (by norm_num) _
    omega
  have h := actualDualCutBound_degreeCast F hq.symm _ B hB
  rw [← dualCoefficientSpace_degreeCast F hq.symm,
    prefixSpace_dualCoefficientSpace_eq_actualStemDualSpace F _ _ P.homogeneous] at h
  exact actualStemCutBudget_le_of_cutBound F _ P.polynomial
    ((wordHomogeneous_iff_mem_homogeneous F _ _).mp P.homogeneous) P.nonzero B h

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.rightCompletion_finrank_le_of_rootCutBound
statement:
theorem rightCompletion_finrank_le_of_rootCutBound (W : DyadicDualData F)
    (n B : ℕ) (hn : n ≠ 0)
    (hB : ActualDualCutBound F (2 ^ strictDyadicRoot n) (W (strictDyadicRoot n)) B) :
    Module.finrank F ((homogeneousRightCompletion F W n).dualAnnihilator) ≤ B
proof:
:= by
  rw [homogeneousRightCompletion_dualAnnihilator_finrank_eq_tensorPrefixSupport F W n hn]
  exact (hB n (2 ^ strictDyadicRoot n - n) (completionRootDegree n)).1

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.leftCompletion_finrank_le_of_rootCutBound
statement:
theorem leftCompletion_finrank_le_of_rootCutBound (W : DyadicDualData F)
    (n B : ℕ) (hn : n ≠ 0)
    (hB : ActualDualCutBound F (2 ^ strictDyadicRoot n) (W (strictDyadicRoot n)) B) :
    Module.finrank F ((homogeneousLeftCompletion F W n).dualAnnihilator) ≤ B
proof:
:= by
  rw [homogeneousLeftCompletion_dualAnnihilator_finrank_eq_tensorSuffixSupport F W n hn]
  exact (hB (2 ^ strictDyadicRoot n - n) n (completionRootDegreeLeft n)).2

name: CriticalGK2.freeMonoidAlgebra_hom_word
statement:
theorem freeMonoidAlgebra_hom_word {F A : Type*} [Field F] [Ring A] [Algebra F A]
    (f : BinaryFreeAlgebra F →ₐ[F] A) (w : FreeMonoid Bool) :
    f (MonoidAlgebra.single w 1) =
      (w.toList.map fun b => f (binaryLetter F b)).prod
proof:
:= by
  have hf : f = binaryEvaluation F A (fun b => f (binaryLetter F b)) := by
    apply freeMonoidAlgebra_hom_ext_letters
    intro b
    simp [binaryEvaluation, binaryLetter]
  calc
    f (MonoidAlgebra.single w 1) =
        binaryEvaluation F A (fun b => f (binaryLetter F b))
          (MonoidAlgebra.single w 1) := DFunLike.congr_fun hf _
    _ = (w.toList.map fun b => f (binaryLetter F b)).prod := by
      simp [binaryEvaluation, FreeMonoid.lift_apply]

name: CriticalGK2.stemEmbedding_word
statement:
theorem stemEmbedding_word (F : Type*) [Field F] (n : ℕ)
    (t : StemWord n → F) (w : FreeMonoid Bool) :
    stemEmbedding F n t (MonoidAlgebra.single w 1) = physicalBlockProduct F n t w
proof:
:=
  freeMonoidAlgebra_hom_word (stemEmbedding F n t) w

name: CriticalGK2.stemEmbedding_mem_repeatedBlockSpace
statement:
theorem stemEmbedding_mem_repeatedBlockSpace (F : Type*) [Field F] (n : ℕ)
    (t : StemWord n → F) (m : ℕ) (P : BinaryFreeAlgebra F)
    (hP : WordHomogeneous m P) :
    stemEmbedding F n t P ∈ repeatedBlockSpace F n t m
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [MonoidAlgebra.lift_unique (stemEmbedding F n t) P]
  change (∑ w ∈ P.support, P w • stemEmbedding F n t (MonoidAlgebra.single w 1)) ∈ _
  apply Submodule.sum_mem
  intro w hw
  apply Submodule.smul_mem
  apply Submodule.subset_span
  refine ⟨w, hP w (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp hw), ?_⟩
  exact stemEmbedding_word F n t w

name: CriticalGK2.localPIBlock_mem_repeatedBlockSpace
statement:
theorem localPIBlock_mem_repeatedBlockSpace (F : Type*) [Field F] (n : ℕ)
    (t : StemWord n → F) (k : ℕ) (u : FreeMonoid Bool) :
    localPIBlock F n t k u ∈
      repeatedBlockSpace F n t ((k * k + 1) * (k * k + 1) + u.length)
proof:
:= by
  apply stemEmbedding_mem_repeatedBlockSpace
  exact wordHomogeneous_mul (codedMatrixPI_homogeneous F (k * k + 1))
    (wordHomogeneous_single u (1 : F))

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.dyadicDoubleDegree
statement: theorem dyadicDoubleDegree (h : ℕ) : 2 ^ h + 2 ^ h = 2 ^ (h + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [pow_succ]
  omega

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.homogeneousDegreeCast_coe
statement:
@[simp]
theorem homogeneousDegreeCast_coe {a b : ℕ} (hab : a = b)
    (x : homogeneous F a) : (homogeneousDegreeCast F hab x).val = x.val
proof:
:= by
  subst b
  rfl

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.homogeneousDualDegreeCast_pairing
statement:
@[simp]
theorem homogeneousDualDegreeCast_pairing {a b : ℕ} (hab : a = b)
    (φ : HomogeneousDual F a) (x : homogeneous F a) :
    homogeneousDualDegreeCast F hab φ (homogeneousDegreeCast F hab x) = φ x
proof:
:= by
  subst b
  rfl

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.homogeneousDualDegreeCast_symm_pairing
statement:
theorem homogeneousDualDegreeCast_symm_pairing {a b : ℕ} (hab : a = b)
    (φ : HomogeneousDual F b) (x : homogeneous F a) :
    φ (homogeneousDegreeCast F hab x) = (homogeneousDualDegreeCast F hab).symm φ x
proof:
:= by
  subst b
  rfl

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.homogeneousDegreeCast_mem_annihilator_iff
statement:
theorem homogeneousDegreeCast_mem_annihilator_iff {a b : ℕ} (hab : a = b)
    (W : Submodule F (HomogeneousDual F b)) (x : homogeneous F a) :
    homogeneousDegreeCast F hab x ∈ W.dualCoannihilator ↔
      x ∈ (W.comap (homogeneousDualDegreeCast F hab).toLinearMap).dualCoannihilator
proof:
:= by
  subst b
  simp [homogeneousDegreeCast, homogeneousDualDegreeCast]

name: CriticalGK2.ContractionBudget.contractRight_mem_tensorPrefixSupport
statement:
theorem contractRight_mem_tensorPrefixSupport (S : Submodule F (X ⊗[F] Y))
    (eta : Module.Dual F Y) (u : X ⊗[F] Y) (hu : u ∈ S) :
    contractRight eta u ∈ tensorPrefixSupport S
proof:
:=
  (le_iSup (fun theta : Module.Dual F Y => S.map (contractRight theta)) eta)
    ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩

name: CriticalGK2.ContractionBudget.extendedPair_mem_tensorSuffixSupport
statement:
theorem extendedPair_mem_tensorSuffixSupport (S : Submodule F (X ⊗[F] Y))
    (phi : Module.Dual F X) (u : X ⊗[F] Y) (hu : u ∈ S) :
    extendedPair phi u ∈ tensorSuffixSupport S
proof:
:=
  (le_iSup (fun psi : Module.Dual F X => S.map (extendedPair psi)) phi)
    ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩

name: CriticalGK2.ContractionBudget.extendedPair_append
statement:
theorem extendedPair_append (phi : Module.Dual F X) (t : X ⊗[F] Y) (z : Z) :
    extendedPair phi (TensorProduct.assoc F X Y Z (t ⊗ₜ[F] z)) =
      extendedPair phi t ⊗ₜ[F] z
proof:
:= by
  induction t using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | add a b ha hb => simp only [add_tmul, map_add, ha, hb]
  | tmul x y => simp only [TensorProduct.assoc_tmul, extendedPair_tmul, smul_tmul']

name: CriticalGK2.ContractionBudget.freeTailTensorSpace_prefixSupport
statement:
theorem freeTailTensorSpace_prefixSupport (t : X ⊗[F] Y) (z0 : Z) (hz0 : z0 ≠ 0) :
    tensorPrefixSupport (freeTailTensorSpace (Z := Z) t) =
      LinearMap.range (leftFlattening t)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · refine iSup_le fun eta => ?_
    rintro x ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := hu
    exact ⟨specializeRight z eta, (leftFlattening_append_apply t z eta).symm⟩
  · rintro x ⟨eta, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨theta, htheta⟩ := specializeRight_surjective z0 hz0 eta
    have hm : TensorProduct.assoc F X Y Z (t ⊗ₜ[F] z0) ∈
        freeTailTensorSpace (Z := Z) t := ⟨z0, rfl⟩
    have hc := contractRight_mem_tensorPrefixSupport
      (freeTailTensorSpace (Z := Z) t) theta _ hm
    have he : contractRight theta (TensorProduct.assoc F X Y Z (t ⊗ₜ[F] z0)) =
        leftFlattening t eta := by
      rw [← leftFlattening_apply, leftFlattening_append_apply, htheta]
    rw [he] at hc
    exact hc

name: CriticalGK2.ContractionBudget.freeTailTensorSpace_suffixSupport
statement:
theorem freeTailTensorSpace_suffixSupport (t : X ⊗[F] Y) :
    tensorSuffixSupport (freeTailTensorSpace (Z := Z) t) =
      scalarExtension (C := Z) (LinearMap.range (rightFlattening t))
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · refine iSup_le fun phi => ?_
    rintro x ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := hu
    let y : LinearMap.range (rightFlattening t) := ⟨rightFlattening t phi, ⟨phi, rfl⟩⟩
    refine ⟨y ⊗ₜ[F] z, ?_⟩
    simp only [LinearMap.rTensor_tmul, Submodule.subtype_apply,
      LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, TensorProduct.mk_apply,
      extendedPair_append, rightFlattening_apply]
    rfl
  · intro x hx
    obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := hx
    induction u using TensorProduct.induction_on with
    | zero =>
        rw [(LinearMap.range (rightFlattening t)).subtype.rTensor Z |>.map_zero]
        exact Submodule.zero_mem _
    | add a b ha hb =>
        rw [map_add]
        exact Submodule.add_mem _ ha hb
    | tmul y z =>
        obtain ⟨phi, hphi⟩ := y.property
        have hm : TensorProduct.assoc F X Y Z (t ⊗ₜ[F] z) ∈
            freeTailTensorSpace (Z := Z) t := ⟨z, rfl⟩
        have hc := extendedPair_mem_tensorSuffixSupport
          (freeTailTensorSpace (Z := Z) t) phi _ hm
        rw [extendedPair_append, ← rightFlattening_apply, hphi] at hc
        simpa only [LinearMap.rTensor_tmul, Submodule.subtype_apply] using hc

name: CriticalGK2.ContractionBudget.scalarExtension_finrank
statement:
theorem scalarExtension_finrank {A B : Type*} [AddCommGroup A] [Module F A]
    [AddCommGroup B] [Module F B] [FiniteDimensional F A] [FiniteDimensional F B]
    (S : Submodule F A) :
    Module.finrank F (scalarExtension (C := B) S) =
      Module.finrank F S * Module.finrank F B
proof:
:= by
  letI : FiniteDimensional F S := FiniteDimensional.of_injective S.subtype Subtype.val_injective
  letI : Module.Free F S := Module.Free.of_basis (Module.Basis.ofVectorSpace F S)
  letI : Module.Free F B := Module.Free.of_basis (Module.Basis.ofVectorSpace F B)
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := S.subtype.exists_leftInverse_of_injective S.ker_subtype
  have hleft : (g.rTensor B).comp (S.subtype.rTensor B) = LinearMap.id := by
    rw [← LinearMap.rTensor_comp, hg, LinearMap.rTensor_id]
  have hinj : Function.Injective (S.subtype.rTensor B) := by
    intro a b hab
    calc
      a = (g.rTensor B) ((S.subtype.rTensor B) a) := (LinearMap.congr_fun hleft a).symm
      _ = (g.rTensor B) ((S.subtype.rTensor B) b) := congrArg (g.rTensor B) hab
      _ = b := LinearMap.congr_fun hleft b
  change Module.finrank F (LinearMap.range (S.subtype.rTensor B)) = _
  rw [LinearMap.finrank_range_of_inj hinj]
  exact Module.finrank_tensorProduct

name: CriticalGK2.ContractionBudget.freeTailTensorSpace_prefixSupport_finrank
statement:
theorem freeTailTensorSpace_prefixSupport_finrank (t : X ⊗[F] Y)
    (z0 : Z) (hz0 : z0 ≠ 0) :
    Module.finrank F (tensorPrefixSupport (freeTailTensorSpace (Z := Z) t)) =
      tensorCutRank t
proof:
:= by
  rw [freeTailTensorSpace_prefixSupport t z0 hz0]
  rfl

name: CriticalGK2.ContractionBudget.freeTailTensorSpace_suffixSupport_finrank
statement:
theorem freeTailTensorSpace_suffixSupport_finrank [FiniteDimensional F X]
    [FiniteDimensional F Y] [FiniteDimensional F Z] (t : X ⊗[F] Y) :
    Module.finrank F (tensorSuffixSupport (freeTailTensorSpace (Z := Z) t)) =
      tensorCutRank t * Module.finrank F Z
proof:
:= by
  rw [freeTailTensorSpace_suffixSupport, scalarExtension_finrank,
    rightFlattening_finrank_eq_left]

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.augmentation_eq_constantCoeff
statement:
theorem augmentation_eq_constantCoeff (x : WordAlgebra F) :
    augmentation F x = x 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction x using Finsupp.induction with
  | zero =>
      change augmentation F (0 : WordAlgebra F) = (0 : F)
      exact map_zero _
  | single_add w c a hwa hc ih =>
      change augmentation F (MonoidAlgebra.single w c + MonoidAlgebra.ofCoeff a) =
        (MonoidAlgebra.single w c) 1 + (MonoidAlgebra.ofCoeff a) 1
      have ih' : augmentation F (MonoidAlgebra.ofCoeff a) =
          (MonoidAlgebra.ofCoeff a) 1 := ih
      rw [map_add, ih']
      congr 1
      rw [augmentation_monomial]
      by_cases hw : w = 1
      · subst w
        simp [MonoidAlgebra.single]
      · have hwlen : w.length ≠ 0 := fun h => hw (FreeMonoid.length_eq_zero.mp h)
        simp [hwlen, MonoidAlgebra.single, Finsupp.single_apply, hw]

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.augmentation_homogeneous_eq_zero
statement:
theorem augmentation_homogeneous_eq_zero (n : ℕ) (hn : n ≠ 0)
    (x : WordAlgebra F) (hx : x ∈ homogeneous F n) : augmentation F x = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [augmentation_eq_constantCoeff]
  exact (mem_homogeneous_iff F n x).mp hx 1 (by simpa using Ne.symm hn)

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.mem_positiveWordSubmodule
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_positiveWordSubmodule (x : WordAlgebra F) :
    x ∈ positiveWordSubmodule F ↔ augmentation F x = 0
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.allCutSubmodule_le_positiveWordSubmodule
statement:
theorem allCutSubmodule_le_positiveWordSubmodule (W : DyadicDualData F) :
    allCutSubmodule F W ≤ positiveWordSubmodule F
proof:
:= by
  apply iSup_le
  intro n x hx
  exact augmentation_homogeneous_eq_zero F (n + 1) (by omega) x
    (allCutComponent_le_homogeneous F W (n + 1) hx)

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.allCutTwoSidedIdeal_le_augmentationIdeal
statement:
theorem allCutTwoSidedIdeal_le_augmentationIdeal (W : DyadicDualData F)
    (hW : PrimalCoherent F W) :
    allCutTwoSidedIdeal F W hW ≤ augmentationIdeal F
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  change augmentation F x = 0
  exact allCutSubmodule_le_positiveWordSubmodule F W
    ((mem_allCutTwoSidedIdeal F W hW x).mp hx)

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.allCutQuotientMap_surjective
statement:
theorem allCutQuotientMap_surjective (W : DyadicDualData F)
    (hW : PrimalCoherent F W) : Function.Surjective (allCutQuotientMap F W hW)
proof:
:=
  RingCon.mkₐ_surjective _

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.allCutQuotientMap_smul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem allCutQuotientMap_smul (W : DyadicDualData F) (hW : PrimalCoherent F W)
    (c : F) (x : WordAlgebra F) :
    allCutQuotientMap F W hW (c • x) = c • allCutQuotientMap F W hW x
proof:
:=
  map_smul _ c x

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.allCutQuotientMap_eq_zero_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem allCutQuotientMap_eq_zero_iff (W : DyadicDualData F)
    (hW : PrimalCoherent F W) (x : WordAlgebra F) :
    allCutQuotientMap F W hW x = 0 ↔ x ∈ allCutSubmodule F W
proof:
:= by
  change (allCutTwoSidedIdeal F W hW).ringCon.mk' x = 0 ↔
    x ∈ allCutSubmodule F W
  rw [← TwoSidedIdeal.mem_ker, TwoSidedIdeal.ker_ringCon_mk',
    mem_allCutTwoSidedIdeal]

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.allCut_congruence_le_augmentation_ker
statement:
theorem allCut_congruence_le_augmentation_ker (W : DyadicDualData F)
    (hW : PrimalCoherent F W) :
    (allCutTwoSidedIdeal F W hW).ringCon ≤ RingCon.ker (augmentation F).toRingHom
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hxy
  apply sub_eq_zero.mp
  rw [← map_sub]
  apply allCutSubmodule_le_positiveWordSubmodule F W
  exact (mem_allCutTwoSidedIdeal F W hW (x - y)).mp
    (((allCutTwoSidedIdeal F W hW).rel_iff x y).mp hxy)

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.allCutQuotientAugmentation_map
statement:
@[simp]
theorem allCutQuotientAugmentation_map (W : DyadicDualData F)
    (hW : PrimalCoherent F W) (x : WordAlgebra F) :
    allCutQuotientAugmentation F W hW (allCutQuotientMap F W hW x) =
      augmentation F x
proof: := rfl

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.mem_positiveAllCutSubalgebra
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_positiveAllCutSubalgebra (W : DyadicDualData F)
    (hW : PrimalCoherent F W) (x : AllCutRingQuotient F W hW) :
    x ∈ positiveAllCutSubalgebra F W hW ↔
      allCutQuotientAugmentation F W hW x = 0
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.positiveAllCutSubalgebra_eq_positive_image
statement:
theorem positiveAllCutSubalgebra_eq_positive_image (W : DyadicDualData F)
    (hW : PrimalCoherent F W) :
    (positiveAllCutSubalgebra F W hW).toSubmodule =
      (positiveWordSubmodule F).map (allCutQuotientMap F W hW).toLinearMap
proof:
:= by
  apply Submodule.ext
  intro x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := allCutQuotientMap_surjective F W hW x
    apply Submodule.mem_map.mpr
    refine ⟨a, ?_, rfl⟩
    change augmentation F a = 0
    exact hx
  · rintro ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
    change augmentation F a = 0
    exact ha

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.positiveAllCutQuotientMap_surjective
statement:
theorem positiveAllCutQuotientMap_surjective (W : DyadicDualData F)
    (hW : PrimalCoherent F W) :
    Function.Surjective (positiveAllCutQuotientMap F W hW)
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := allCutQuotientMap_surjective F W hW x.val
  have hapos : a ∈ positiveWordSubmodule F := by
    change augmentation F a = 0
    rw [← allCutQuotientAugmentation_map F W hW, ha]
    exact x.property
  exact ⟨⟨a, hapos⟩, Subtype.ext ha⟩

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.positiveAllCutQuotientMap_ker
statement:
theorem positiveAllCutQuotientMap_ker (W : DyadicDualData F)
    (hW : PrimalCoherent F W) :
    (positiveAllCutQuotientMap F W hW).ker =
      (allCutSubmodule F W).comap (positiveWordSubmodule F).subtype
proof:
:= by
  apply Submodule.ext
  intro x
  change positiveAllCutQuotientMap F W hW x = 0 ↔ x.val ∈ allCutSubmodule F W
  rw [← allCutQuotientMap_eq_zero_iff F W hW x.val]
  exact Subtype.ext_iff

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.exists_homogeneous_quotient_ne_zero
statement:
theorem exists_homogeneous_quotient_ne_zero (W : DyadicDualData F)
    (hW : PrimalCoherent F W) (n : ℕ) (hn : n ≠ 0)
    (hWroot : W (strictDyadicRoot n) ≠ ⊥) :
    ∃ x : WordAlgebra F, x ∈ homogeneous F n ∧ allCutQuotientMap F W hW x ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_contra h
  push_neg at h
  apply allCutComponent_ne_homogeneous F W n hn hWroot
  apply le_antisymm (allCutComponent_le_homogeneous F W n)
  intro x hx
  have hE := (allCutQuotientMap_eq_zero_iff F W hW x).mp (h x hx)
  have hboth : x ∈ allCutSubmodule F W ⊓ homogeneous F n := ⟨hE, hx⟩
  rwa [allCutSubmodule_inf_homogeneous] at hboth

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.exists_positive_homogeneous_ne_zero
statement:
theorem exists_positive_homogeneous_ne_zero (W : DyadicDualData F)
    (hW : PrimalCoherent F W) (n : ℕ) (hn : n ≠ 0)
    (hWroot : W (strictDyadicRoot n) ≠ ⊥) :
    ∃ a : PositiveAllCutQuotient F W hW, a ≠ 0 ∧
      ∃ x : WordAlgebra F, x ∈ homogeneous F n ∧
        allCutQuotientMap F W hW x = a.val
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hxne⟩ := exists_homogeneous_quotient_ne_zero F W hW n hn hWroot
  have hxpos := augmentation_homogeneous_eq_zero F n hn x hx
  refine ⟨⟨allCutQuotientMap F W hW x, hxpos⟩, ?_, x, hx, rfl⟩
  intro ha
  exact hxne (congrArg Subtype.val ha)

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.word_mul_ne_one_of_left
statement: theorem word_mul_ne_one_of_left (u v : Word) (hu : u ≠ 1) : u * v ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  intro he
  have hlen := congrArg FreeMonoid.length he
  have huLen : u.length ≠ 0 := fun h => hu (FreeMonoid.length_eq_zero.mp h)
  rw [FreeMonoid.length_mul] at hlen
  change u.length + v.length = 0 at hlen
  apply huLen
  omega

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.positiveWordImage_mul
statement:
theorem positiveWordImage_mul (W : DyadicDualData F) (hW : PrimalCoherent F W)
    (u v : Word) (hu : u ≠ 1) (hv : v ≠ 1) :
    positiveWordImage F W hW (u * v) (word_mul_ne_one_of_left u v hu) =
      positiveWordImage F W hW u hu * positiveWordImage F W hW v hv
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change quotientWord F W hW (u * v) = quotientWord F W hW u * quotientWord F W hW v
  exact quotientWord_mul F W hW u v

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.positiveWordImage_letter
statement:
theorem positiveWordImage_letter (W : DyadicDualData F) (hW : PrimalCoherent F W)
    (b : Bool) (hb : (FreeMonoid.of b : Word) ≠ 1) :
    positiveWordImage F W hW (FreeMonoid.of b) hb = positiveGenerator F W hW b
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  rfl

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.boundedPositiveWord_ne_one
statement: theorem boundedPositiveWord_ne_one (N : ℕ) (w : BoundedPositiveWord N) : w.val ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hlen := w.property.1
  rw [h] at hlen
  exact Nat.not_lt_zero _ hlen

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.boundedPositiveWordImage_mem_degreeFiltration
statement:
theorem boundedPositiveWordImage_mem_degreeFiltration (W : DyadicDualData F)
    (hW : PrimalCoherent F W) (N : ℕ) (w : BoundedPositiveWord N) :
    boundedPositiveWordImage F W hW N w ∈ positiveDegreeFiltration F W hW N
proof:
:= by
  have hwpos := w.property.1
  have hwbound := w.property.2
  let m : ℕ := w.val.length - 1
  have hdegree : w.val.length = m + 1 := by dsimp [m]; omega
  have hm : m < N := by dsimp [m]; omega
  let x : homogeneous F (m + 1) :=
    ⟨MonoidAlgebra.single w.val 1, monomial_mem_homogeneous F (m + 1)
      ⟨w.val, hdegree⟩ 1⟩
  have hx := homogeneousToPositiveQuotient_mem_filtration F W hW m N hm x
  have heq : homogeneousToPositiveQuotient F W hW (m + 1) (by omega) x =
      boundedPositiveWordImage F W hW N w := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    rfl
  rw [heq] at hx
  exact hx

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.positiveWordFiltration_le_degreeFiltration
statement:
theorem positiveWordFiltration_le_degreeFiltration (W : DyadicDualData F)
    (hW : PrimalCoherent F W) (N : ℕ) :
    positiveWordFiltration F W hW N ≤ positiveDegreeFiltration F W hW N
proof:
:= by
  apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
  rintro a ⟨w, rfl⟩
  exact boundedPositiveWordImage_mem_degreeFiltration F W hW N w

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.positiveDegreeFiltration_le_wordFiltration
statement:
theorem positiveDegreeFiltration_le_wordFiltration (W : DyadicDualData F)
    (hW : PrimalCoherent F W) (N : ℕ) :
    positiveDegreeFiltration F W hW N ≤ positiveWordFiltration F W hW N
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold positiveDegreeFiltration
  apply Finset.sup_le
  intro m hm
  rintro a ⟨q, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective
    ((allCutComponent F W (m + 1)).comap (homogeneous F (m + 1)).subtype) q
  rw [← hx, componentQuotientToPositive_mk,
    ← (homogeneousWordBasis F (m + 1)).sum_repr x, map_sum]
  apply Submodule.sum_mem
  intro w _
  rw [map_smul]
  apply Submodule.smul_mem
  let wb : BoundedPositiveWord N :=
    ⟨w.val, by rw [w.property]; omega, by
      rw [w.property]
      have hm' := Finset.mem_range.mp hm
      omega⟩
  have heq : homogeneousToPositiveQuotient F W hW (m + 1) (by omega)
      (homogeneousWordBasis F (m + 1) w) = boundedPositiveWordImage F W hW N wb := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    change allCutQuotientMap F W hW (homogeneousWordBasis F (m + 1) w).val =
      allCutQuotientMap F W hW (MonoidAlgebra.single w.val 1)
    rw [homogeneousWordBasis_coe]
  rw [heq]
  exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨wb, rfl⟩

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.positiveDegreeFiltration_eq_wordFiltration
statement:
theorem positiveDegreeFiltration_eq_wordFiltration (W : DyadicDualData F)
    (hW : PrimalCoherent F W) (N : ℕ) :
    positiveDegreeFiltration F W hW N = positiveWordFiltration F W hW N
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (positiveDegreeFiltration_le_wordFiltration F W hW N)
    (positiveWordFiltration_le_degreeFiltration F W hW N)

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.positiveDegreeGrowth_eq_wordSpan_finrank
statement:
theorem positiveDegreeGrowth_eq_wordSpan_finrank (W : DyadicDualData F)
    (hW : PrimalCoherent F W) (N : ℕ) :
    positiveDegreeGrowth F W hW N =
      Module.finrank F (Submodule.span F (Set.range (boundedPositiveWordImage F W hW N)))
proof:
:= by
  unfold positiveDegreeGrowth
  rw [positiveDegreeFiltration_eq_wordFiltration]
  rfl

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.sparseDegreeGrowth_scheduled_upper
statement:
theorem sparseDegreeGrowth_scheduled_upper (Λ : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hΛ : EnvelopeDiverges Λ) (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) :
    sparseDegreeGrowth F Λ hΛ n ≤ n * (n + 1) *
      supportBudget targetCost (begunOperationCount Λ hΛ (strictDyadicRoot n)) ^ 2
proof:
:=
  sparseDegreeGrowth_le_scheduled_budget_of_cutBounds F Λ hΛ
    (sparseDualData_cutBound F Λ hΛ) n hn

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.sparseDegreeGrowth_near_two_upper
statement:
theorem sparseDegreeGrowth_near_two_upper (Λ : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hΛ : EnvelopeDiverges Λ) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    2 + ε ∈ CriticalGK2.Growth.UpperExponentSet (sparseDegreeGrowth F Λ hΛ)
proof:
:=
  sparseDegreeGrowth_near_two_upper_of_cutBounds F Λ hΛ
    (sparseDualData_cutBound F Λ hΛ) ε hε

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.sparseDegreeGrowth_gkExponent_eq_two
statement:
theorem sparseDegreeGrowth_gkExponent_eq_two (Λ : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hΛ : EnvelopeDiverges Λ) :
    CriticalGK2.Growth.GKExponent (sparseDegreeGrowth F Λ hΛ) = 2
proof:
:=
  sparseDegreeGrowth_gkExponent_eq_two_of_cutBounds F Λ hΛ
    (sparseDualData_cutBound F Λ hΛ)

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.sparseDegreeGrowth_envelope_upper
statement:
theorem sparseDegreeGrowth_envelope_upper (Λ : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hΛ : EnvelopeDiverges Λ) (hmono : Monotone Λ)
    (hone : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → 1 ≤ Λ n) (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) :
    (sparseDegreeGrowth F Λ hΛ n : ℝ) ≤ 4 * ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 * Λ n
proof:
:=
  sparseDegreeGrowth_envelope_upper_of_cutBounds F Λ hΛ hmono hone
    (sparseDualData_cutBound F Λ hΛ) n hn

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.originalFieldDegreeGrowth_eq_wordSpan_finrank
statement:
theorem originalFieldDegreeGrowth_eq_wordSpan_finrank (n : ℕ) :
    originalFieldDegreeGrowth F n = Module.finrank F
      (Submodule.span F (Set.range (boundedPositiveWordImage F
        (sparseDualData F (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ)) linearEnvelope_diverges)
        (sparseDualData_primalCoherent F (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ)) linearEnvelope_diverges) n)))
proof:
:=
  positiveDegreeGrowth_eq_wordSpan_finrank F _ _ n

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.originalFieldDegreeGrowth_gkExponent_eq_two
statement:
theorem originalFieldDegreeGrowth_gkExponent_eq_two :
    CriticalGK2.Growth.GKExponent (originalFieldDegreeGrowth F) = 2
proof:
:=
  sparseDegreeGrowth_gkExponent_eq_two F _ linearEnvelope_diverges

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.originalField_critical_gk_two_absolute_nil_endpoint
statement:
theorem originalField_critical_gk_two_absolute_nil_endpoint :
    (¬ Module.Finite F (OriginalFieldNilAlgebra F)) ∧
    (NonUnitalAlgebra.adjoin F (Set.range (originalFieldGenerator F)) = ⊤) ∧
    (CriticalGK2.Growth.GKExponent (originalFieldDegreeGrowth F) = 2) ∧
    (∀ n : ℕ, n * (n + 3) ≤ 2 * originalFieldDegreeGrowth F n) ∧
    (∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε →
      2 + ε ∈ CriticalGK2.Growth.UpperExponentSet (originalFieldDegreeGrowth F)) ∧
    (∀ (K : Type*) [Field K] [Algebra F K],
      (∀ r : ℕ, 0 < r →
        ∀ M : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ((OriginalFieldNilAlgebra F) ⊗[F] K),
          ∃ e : ℕ, positivePower M e = 0) ∧
      (∀ r : ℕ, 0 < r → Algebra.IsAlgebraic K
        (Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) (Unitization K (K ⊗[F] (OriginalFieldNilAlgebra F))))))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hinf, hgen, hext⟩ := originalField_constructed_absolute_nil_endpoint F
  exact ⟨hinf, hgen, originalFieldDegreeGrowth_gkExponent_eq_two F,
    originalFieldDegreeGrowth_quadratic_lower F,
    sparseDegreeGrowth_near_two_upper F _ linearEnvelope_diverges, hext⟩

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.completionRootDegree
